title: Single Number
statement: Every value appears exactly twice except one, which appears once. Return that one. Use linear time and constant extra space.
constraints: every element appears twice except one
hints: A HashSet solves it but costs O(n) space, which the problem forbids.
You need an operation where combining a value with itself cancels out.
XOR does exactly that: x ^ x is 0 and x ^ 0 is x. XOR the whole array together.
